zh: 优化工具市场展示与权限控制：已在工具列表的工具与平台托管应用（如 AiOps-Report）在工具市场中正确显示「打开」按钮而非「加入我的工具」；严格限制 Python Web 托管应用包仅超级管理员可上传导入与预览，团队普通管理员界面提示与包检测将实时拦截非超管上传。
en: Improve tool market display and upload permissions: tools and hosted apps already in the user's tools list (such as AiOps-Report) now show 'Open' instead of 'Add to My Tools'; Python Web hosted app packages are strictly restricted to super administrators for uploading and previewing, with immediate UI blocking for non-super admins.
